source: hand-maintained; single source of truth for module data

modules.name: Absolute Zero
modules.description: Freezes time itself. Equipping your tower with this module slows the passage of time itself by 50%. Why did you go that far?

modules.name: Adaptive Regeneration
modules.description: Automatically repairs the tower by an amount based on its maximum hitpoints. Can not be further amplified by other modules that increase the hitpoint regeneration.

modules.name: Advanced Heal
modules.description: Instantly refills a percentage of the tower's maximum hitpoints.

modules.name: Advanced Shield
modules.description: Provides the tower with an advanced shield, but disables health regeneration.

modules.name: Advanced Splash
modules.description: Provides a 20% chance to damage enemies close to your primary target by a portion of your damage dealt to the primary target itself.

modules.name: Aero Core
modules.description: Changes the base type of the tower from Neutral to Air and therefore applies all default strengths and weaknesses of Air to it. If other modules that change the element of the owner are present then the one with the highest type priority overrides the others. Type priority: 4

modules.name: Aftershock
modules.description: Provides a {chance}% chance to stun all units in a 10M radius around the tower whenever any active module is used. Has an internal 3 sec. cooldown after triggering.

modules.name: Air Armor
modules.description: Reduces incoming Air damage by a fixed amount.

modules.name: Air Attack
modules.description: Provides the tower some basic Air damage on every attack.

modules.name: Air Barrier
modules.description: Damages attackers by an amount (based on your max. shield points) of damage type Air as long as your current shield points are greater than 0.

modules.name: Air Block
modules.description: Provides a chance to fully block incoming Air damage.

modules.name: Air Burst
modules.description: Provides the tower a 20% chance to deal additional Air damage on an attack.

modules.name: Air Crit
modules.description: Provides a chance to multiply your projectile's Air damage.

modules.name: Air Exchange
modules.description: Divides incoming Air damage by a certain amount while at the same time multiplying incoming Earth damage.

modules.name: Air Focus
modules.description: Increases Air damage dealt by the tower for 45 seconds.

modules.name: Air Impetus
modules.description: Increases the total Air damage of the tower based on the distance between the target and the tower at the moment the projectile arrives.

modules.name: Air Protection
modules.description: Increases your Air armor (abs. resistance) by an amount that is based on the maximum shield value of the tower. Bonus is only active when the shield is active.

modules.name: Air Resistance
modules.description: Reduces incoming Air damage by a percent based amount.

modules.name: Air Shell
modules.description: Increases resistance against Air damage everytime the tower takes damage of the specified type. Stacks up to 50 times (multiplicatively) and lasts up to 4 seconds. Taking damage of the same type again refreshes the duration.

modules.name: Air Slice
modules.description: Provides a {chance}% chance to create a gush of wind around the primary target that damages all nearby units and slows their attackspeed.

modules.name: Air Splash
modules.description: Provides a 20% chance to damage all enemies in a 8M radius around the primary target by a fixed amount. Damage type is Air.

modules.name: Air Subsistence
modules.description: Increases your Air damage based on your current energy percentage. Full bonus is applied at 100% energy. Drains 200 energy whenever the bonus is applied.

modules.name: Air Taste
modules.description: Deals additional damage of type Air based on a percentage of the total raw damage dealt (without any modifiers). Damage of Taste modules does not alter the total raw damage dealt and therefore cannot influence other Taste modules.

modules.name: Angelic Core
modules.description: Changes the base type of the Tower from Neutral to Light and therefore applies all default strengths and weaknesses of Light to it. If other modules that change the element of the Tower are present then the one with the highest type priority overrides the others.Type priority: 6

modules.name: Anti-Air Crit
modules.description: Provides a chance to multiply your damage against Air enemies by min(tier - 1, 4).

modules.name: Anti-Air Projectiles
modules.description: Increases the damage dealt against Air enemies.

modules.name: Anti-Darkness Projectiles
modules.description: Increases the damage dealt against Darkness enemies.

modules.name: Anti-Earth Projectiles

modules.name: Anti-Electricity Projectiles

modules.name: Anti-Fire Projectiles
modules.description: Increases the damage dealt against Fire enemies.

modules.name: Anti-Light Projectiles
modules.description: Increases the damage dealt against Light enemies.

modules.name: Anti-Nature Projectiles
modules.description: Increases the damage dealt against Nature enemies.

modules.name: Anti-Neutral Crit
modules.description: Provides a chance to multiply your damage against Neutral enemies by min(4, tier-1).

modules.name: Anti-Neutral Projectiles
modules.description: Increases the damage dealt against Neutral enemies.

modules.name: Anti-Universal Crit
modules.description: Provides a chance to multiply your damage against universal enemies by min(4, tier-1).

modules.name: Anti-Universal Projectiles
modules.description: Increases the damage dealt against Universal enemies.

modules.name: Anti-Water Crit
modules.description: Provides a chance to multiply your damage against Water enemies by min(tier - 1, 4).

modules.name: Anti-Water Projectiles
modules.description: Increases the damage dealt against Water enemies.

modules.name: Aquatic Absorption
modules.description: Whenever a Water enemy is being destroyed the owner of this module has a {10 + 0.1*(tier - 1)}% [chance] to refill a percentage based amount of their shield.

modules.name: Attack Speed
modules.description: Modifies the tower's attack speed.

modules.name: Aura Enhancement
modules.unlock: Beat Perfect Space with Rocket Launcher
modules.description: Increases the radius of all aura modules for {30 + 0.08*(tier - 1)} seconds. Every module with "aura" in its name is considered an aura.

modules.name: Avalanche
modules.description: Provides a chance to multiply your outgoing projectile Earth damage by an exponential part of your Earth armor. The current multiplier is x^{exponent} where x represents your current Earth armor. The multiplier cannot be lower than 1.

modules.name: Awareness
modules.description: Temporarily increases the experience points gained from destroyed enemies. (Refers to ingame XP, not town XP.)

modules.name: Bash
modules.description: Provides a small chance to stun a target for a short duration. Stunned units cannot move or attack.

modules.name: Basic Attack
modules.description: Provides the tower some basic Neutral damage.

modules.name: Basic Bouncing
modules.description: Provides the projectiles a chance to bounce off to additional targets. Does not bounce off to the same unit twice. The chance is calculated for each target separately so the missile might bounce off fewer times than the limit.

modules.name: Basic Regeneration
modules.description: Supplies the tower with the ability to slowly regenerate itself.

modules.name: Basic Shield
modules.description: Provides the tower with a shield that absorbs damage.

modules.name: Battery Foundation
modules.description: A very energetic foundation that provides some hitpoints and multiplies outgoing Electricity damage by 50. Outgoing attacks receive an additional damage bonus based on the current energy percentage of the tower. The bonus gets exponentially weaker the lower the energy percentage gets.

modules.name: Beach Gift
modules.description: Provides bonus energy regeneration that alternates between 0% and the current bonus amount in 1 minute cycles like a sine wave.

modules.name: Bluecat's Harmonizer
modules.description: Reduces the cooldown of all active modules by 20% but prevents their Energy cost from getting lower than 20% of the tower's max. Energy. Modules that cost 0 energy to active or toggle are not affected by this. Additionally outgoing damage gets multiplied based on the amount of positive and negative buffs present on the tower.

modules.name: Borf
modules.unlock: Beat Perfect Space with Gauss Cannon
modules.description: Permastuns the tower but in exchange reduces the cooldown and energy cost of all offensive modules by 90%. The cooldown of all other modules increases by 100%

modules.name: Boss Shield
modules.description: Reduces the incoming damage from Boss enemies.

modules.name: Bulletproof
modules.description: Provides resistance against incoming damage from ranged units like archers and wizards.

modules.name: Bulwark
modules.description: Increases the tower's damage the closer its hitpoints are to 50%. Passively multiplies the tower's maximum hitpoints and all armors by 1000.

modules.name: Burning Attack
modules.description: Provides a 10% chance to ignite all enemies in a large area around the primary target, burning them for a specific amount of Fire damage each second. Lasts up to 5 seconds.

modules.name: Captain's Reflect
modules.description: Reflects a part of incoming damage as pure damage when activated. Lasts up to 5 seconds.

modules.name: Chaos Gift
modules.description: Provides a 1+((tier-1)/4)% chance to cast an active module with a ground target a second time at a random location within the casters attack range with no additional cost. The second cast does not trigger any modules that react to active modules.

modules.name: Checkerboard Aura
modules.description: Reduces the base resistance of nearby enemies against Neutral and Universal damage. Negative base resistance amplifies damage of the according element type.

modules.name: Combustion
modules.description: Provides a {chance} chance that a destroyed enemy will explode and deal a part of its maximum hitpoints as Fire damage to surrounding enemies.

modules.name: Condense
modules.description: Provides a small change to receive an exotic gem from destroying a Boss enemy.

modules.name: Conductor
modules.description: Converts a part of the incoming damage to shield points.

modules.name: Confusion Field
modules.description: All units in the targeted area temporarily change their ownership to the owner of this module. They additionally gain a multiplicative bonus to their attack damage. Lasts up to 15 sec. and has a radius of {5 + 0.03*(tier - 1)} M.

modules.name: Cooling Cell
modules.unlock: Beat Perfect Space with Gatling Gun
modules.description: Absorbs and resets the cooldown of all offensive, defensive and ultimate modules that are currently on cooldown and applies the cooldown to this module instead. The sum of the cooldowns is additionally multiplied by a factor that cannot be reduced via any cooldown reduction bonus.

modules.name: Crate of Rex
modules.description: Divides all resource drops from enemies while at the same time multiplying all xp drops by a constant factor. Can be toggled to swap the division and multiplication around.

modules.name: Critical Strike
modules.description: Provides a chance to deal more damage on an attack.

modules.name: Daigoparry
modules.description: Parry the next 15 hits that would kill you

modules.name: Dark Realm Gift
modules.description: Reduces the energy cost of active offensive modules.

modules.name: Dark Sacrifice
modules.description: Sacrifices 30% of the tower's current HP and in turn increases it's dark damage multiplicatively by [sacrificed amount * {1 + max(0, 0.01*(tier - 5))}]^0.2 for a certain amount of time

modules.description: Applies a part of module and damage factor related Light damage bonus to Nature damage as well.

modules.name: Death Aura
modules.description: Provides a chance for each individual non-Boss enemy around the tower to immediat[e]ly die once every second.

modules.name: Death Wish
modules.description: Increases outgoing damage by a certain % and incoming damage by half of that amount.

modules.name: Deep Slumber
modules.description: Provides a chance to stun the primary target for one year. If the attempt fails, the target will become immune to the effects of this ability for a certain amount of time.

modules.name: Defense Overload
modules.description: Provides a 15% chance when casting a defensive ability to refill 20% of the maximum shield amount and supply the tower with a buff that divides incoming damage of any type and lasts up to 5 seconds. Stacks up to 50 times.

modules.name: Defensive Pack
modules.description: Provides a chance to upgrade a random defensive module at the beginning of a new wave for free.

modules.name: Defiance
modules.description: Everytime the tower is hit by death blow, all surrounding enemies will be stunned for 3 seconds and the tower survives with 1 HP left. Can only trigger once every few seconds.

modules.name: Desert Gift
modules.description: Increases Neutral, Light, Fire and Earth damage while also increasing the resistance against these elements by the same value.

modules.name: Desperado
modules.description: Sprays the surrounding area full of lead, hitting all enemies anywhere from 0 to 2 times.

modules.name: Diamond Foundation
modules.description: This crystalized foundation provides a lot of hitpoints but becomes fragile if damaged. Divides incoming damage by a fixed factor that gets lower along with the hitpoints of the tower. At 1/3 of max. health there is a turning point where incoming damage is being amplified.

modules.name: Dice of Fate
modules.description: Use the power of this artifact to get random buff every few seconds. Has a chance to apply a negative buff.

modules.name: Dispel
modules.description: Removes a negative buff from the tower.

modules.name: Diver's Shield
modules.description: Provides a 25% change whenever any active module is being used to make the Tower immune to Water damage for a certain amount of time.

modules.name: Divine Blessing
modules.description: Provides a chance to damage an enemy by 5% of the tower's current hitpoints and to temporarily increase the tower's maximum hitpoints. Every second the total amount of bonus HP reduces by 1% of its current value.

modules.name: Division Shield
modules.description: Divides incoming damage by a fixed amount. Affects all damage types.

modules.name: Dryness Aura
modules.description: Reduces the base resistance of nearby enemies against Light, Water, Air and Electricity damage. Negative base resistance amplifies damage of the according element type.

modules.description: Provides a chance to multiply outgoing damage. The chance is based on the current %-based hitpoints of the tower where 100% health provides a 0% chance and 0% health provides a 100% chance.

modules.name: Energy
modules.description: Provides the tower with Energy which can be used to activate active skills.

modules.name: Energy Flow
modules.description: Reduces the cooldown of active modules.

modules.name: Energy Recycling
modules.description: Reduces the energy cost of all modules that require energy.

modules.name: Energy Regeneration
modules.description: Provides the tower the ability to passively regenerate energy.

modules.name: Energy Sphere
modules.description: Reflects a massive amount of damage when toggled active as long as the current amount of Energy is greater than 0 while at the same time draining 2% of your max. Energy per second and preventing any form of passive Energy Regeneration. The damage is of the same element as the Tower.

modules.name: Eternal Wall
modules.description: Tremendously increases the hitpoints of the tower by raising them to a specific power.

modules.name: Execution
modules.description: Allows the tower to deal additional Universal damage to an enemy if its hitpoints are below {threshold} of their maximum value.

modules.name: Extinguish
modules.description: Provides a chance to instantly destroy a fire enemy on an attack.

modules.name: Fiery Aura
modules.description: Damages enemies which are very close to the tower by a fixed amount and by an amount that is based on their current hitpoints. The fixed amount of damage is affected by amplifiers and bonuses and is applied independently from the %-based amount.

modules.description: Unleashes a powerful firestorm at the targeted location which damages enemies by 40% of their max. hitpoints + a fixed amount of damage.

modules.name: Focused Multishot
modules.description: Provides a chance to attack up to 10 units around the primary target.

modules.name: Forest Gift
modules.description: Increases Neutral, Fire, Earth and Nature damage while also increasing the resistance against these elements by the same value.

modules.name: Fracture
modules.description: Temporarily subtracts 500% of the tower's resistance (post-additive) but in turn multiplies all outgoing damage by a constant factor.

modules.name: Frost Aura
modules.description: Slows the movementspeed of enemies in a 20M radius around the tower.

modules.name: Frost Nova
modules.description: Releases a wave of frost around the tower. Enemies affected by the cold cannot move for {duration} seconds.

modules.name: Frost Splash
modules.description: Provides a {chance}% chance to slow the movement speed of all enemies in a large area around the primary target for 3 seconds. Stacks with other slowing effects.

modules.name: Gaia Synergy
modules.description: Multiplies the total Earth damage multiplier with the total Nature damage multiplier raised to a certain power. Does the same thing vice versa.

modules.name: Gaia's Path
modules.description: Projectiles that hit Nature enemies will start to bounce off to nearby targets, bouncing a total of 3 times, dealing Nature damage to additional targets.

modules.name: Gaia's Protection
modules.description: Reduces the duration of debuffs by 100% for a specific amount of time.

modules.name: Generic Armor
modules.description: Reduces any Non-pure incoming damage by a fixed amount. Always applied after percentage based reduction. Additionally reduces the attack range of the tower by 75%.

modules.name: Generic Resistance
modules.description: Reduce any incoming damage by a percentage based amount.

modules.name: Gigantic Vines
modules.description: Spawns huge vines all over the map (requires solid ground). Enemies getting too close to the vines will receive a negative buff that slows their movement and attackspeed by 33% and deals {damage}% of their current hitpoints as Nature damage to them.

modules.name: Glacier Spikes
modules.description: Spawns multiple ice pillars at random positions around the map (requires solid ground). Enemies that get too close to the pillars will take a fixed amount of water damage multiplied by the tower's water armor raised to the power of {armor} (multiplier cannot be lower than 1) and have their movement- and attackspeed slowed by 90%. The pillars will disappear after 20 seconds.

modules.name: Gnarly Obsidian
modules.description: Passively multiplies Fire armor. Provides a chance to change the element of an attacker to Fire and stun them in the process for 5 seconds.

modules.name: Google's Influence
modules.description: Increases the area of effect of all modules inside a specific category and reduces it for all the others. Using this module again cycles through all available modes which contain "spells" (active modules), "passive" (passive area effects) and "auras" (modules with aura in their name). Starts off with "spells".Google_HQ's influence made this module suddenly appear.

modules.name: Granite Foundation
modules.description: A stronger foundation that provides more hitpoints than the stone foundation but in turn slows the attack speed of the tower by increasing the cooldown between attacks by (80-10*min(tier,5))%.

modules.name: Gravel
modules.description: Provides a chance to produce gravel around the tower when attacking (displayed as a buff). Whenever an enemy attacks it gets stunned by 0.1 seconds for each layer of the buff and the incoming damage gets reduced by 33% per layer (multiplicative). Stacks up to 50 times and disappears when taking damage.

modules.name: Gravitational Impact
modules.description: Provides a chance to deal a huge amount of damage to all enemies close to the primary target whenever attacking a Universal type enemy. Splash damage type is Universal.

modules.name: Grim Reaper
modules.description: Provides a 25+((tier-1)/4)% chance to apply a debuff to an enemy. If an enemy already contains the Grim Reaper debuff it will die instantly. The debuff lasts up to 10 seconds. Does not work on Darkness or Boss enemies.

modules.name: Growth
modules.description: Increases the maximum hitpoints over time additively. That means hitpoints gained from this module are not factored in into future gains from it.

modules.name: Headhunting
modules.description: Increases the damage against non-Normal enemy types. Includes Archers, Assassins, Wizards, Tanks and Bosses.

modules.name: Heartstopper Aura
modules.description: Decreases the hitpoints of nearby non-Boss units by a percentage based amount of damage type Darkness.

modules.name: Heatwave
modules.description: Provides a {chance}% chance to ignite all units in a 15m radius around the tower whenever an active module is used. Burning units take damage equal to 10% of their current HP plus a fixed amount per second. Damage type is Fire.

modules.name: Heaven Gift
modules.description: Multiplies the max. energy amount of the owner by 1.1tier. Has no effect if the owner has no energy at all.

modules.name: High Mountain Gift
modules.description: Increases the area of effect of all active modules by a specific amount

modules.name: High Tide
modules.description: Reduces the energy cost of all active modules but in exchange increases the cooldown of Ultimate active modules by 25%.

modules.name: Hurricane
modules.description: Increases the attack speed by 40%, all Air damage dealt by 5000% and attack range of the tower by 20%.

modules.name: Ice Breath
modules.description: Provides a chance to release a wave of frost that deals little damage and freezes all enemies in a straight line for 1.2 seconds.

modules.description: Provides a chance to multiply your projectile's Water damage.

modules.name: Water Exchange
modules.description: Divides incoming Water damage by a certain amount while at the same time multiplying incoming Fire damage.

modules.name: Water Focus
modules.description: Increases Water damage dealt by the tower for 45 seconds.

modules.name: Water Impetus
modules.description: Increases the total Water damage of the tower based on the distance between the target and the tower at the moment the projectile arrives.

modules.name: Water Protection
modules.description: Increases your Water armor (abs. resistance) by an amount that is based on the maximum shield value of the tower. Bonus is only active when the shield is active.

modules.name: Water Resistance
modules.description: Reduces incoming Water damage by a percent based amount.

modules.name: Water Shell
modules.description: Increases resistance against Water damage everytime the tower takes damage of the specified type. Stacks up to 50 times (multiplicatively) and lasts up to 4 seconds. Taking damage of the same type again refreshes the duration.

modules.name: Water Splash
modules.description: Provides a 20% chance to damage all enemies in a 8M radius around the primary target by a fixed amount. Damage type is Water.

modules.name: Water Subsistence
modules.description: Increases your Water damage based on your current energy percentage. Full bonus is applied at 100% energy. Drains 200 energy whenever the bonus is applied.

modules.name: Water Taste
modules.description: Deals additional damage of type Water based on a percentage of the total raw damage dealt (without any modifiers). Damage of Taste modules does not alter the total raw damage dealt and therefore cannot influence other Taste modules.

modules.name: Wave Resources
modules.description: Produces a fixed amount of Town Resources at the beginning of a new wave.

modules.name: Whirlwind Aura
modules.description: Slows the attackspeed of nearby enemies.

modules.name: Winter Gift
modules.description: Reduces the total duration of negative buffs. Stuns also count as negative buffs.

modules.name: XP Bonus
modules.description: Increases the amount of experience gained for destroying enemies.
